text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-4821|INC-4821> - deploy rollout: error-rate spike on /v1/generate (canary) — region: us-west-2. auto-page: on-call

pagerduty: Trigger details: service=runtime-canary, severity=critical, symptom=5xx surge, current_error_rate=12.4% (baseline 0.3%), affected_pct_of_traffic=9.8% (canary weight=10%).

elena (on-call): acked and joining. seeing the same in grafana. can someone paste canary release id?

malik (eng): that was a roll of runtime-image:v2026-05-17-quant (canary id=rel-20260517-c). changed kernel selection for int8 path. also enabled safety-net circuit-breaker tweak.

jess (sre): note: pager shows spike started at 1850012300, right after rollout start. probable correlation.

ana (prod-support): incoming customer tickets: 3 customers reporting timeouts in the last 10m, all on endpoints hitting generate. high priority: acme-inc, beta-labs. passing to eng for impact calc.

malik (eng): collecting logs now. early pointer: repeated model-inference failures with "KVCache corruption" errors + worker restarts. snippet from canary pod logs:

```
runtime/serve: panic: kvcache: invalid kv length
stack: github.com/redwood/serve.(*kv).Get
  /workspace/serve/kv.go:142
  ...
exit status 2
```

elena (on-call): ok we need to stop canary traffic and consider rollback. can we set canary weight to 0?

devops-bot: Command executed: `trafficctl update-weight --deployment=rel-20260517-c --weight=0 --env=prod` -> accepted (queued).

incident-bot: automation: safety-net: activating circuit-breaker for service=runtime-canary, action=reject-new-requests.

pagerduty: Escalation: notif sent to escalation policy level 2.

malik (eng): i'm rolling a rollback now to previous stable (rel-20260430-b). running: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=198` and kicking off canary rebuild without the int8 kernel change.

elena (on-call): thanks. monitoring latency and 5xx now.

devops-bot: Rollout command executed by malik: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=198` (job id: rb-1850012367).

jess (sre): can we also scale the canary pods down to 0 to avoid unhealthy pods flapping? `kubectl scale deployment/runtime-canary --replicas=0 -n prod`

malik (eng): scaling now. logs show pod terminations successful.

ana (prod-support): update: acme-inc severity reduced — they see recovery for their requests. will keep monitoring.

elena (on-call): current metrics: error_rate overall for service back to 0.5% (from 12.4%), latency back near baseline. nice work.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-4821 acknowledged by elena (on-call), status -> in_progress.

pagerduty: Incident status changed: active -> mitigated (traffic shifted + rollback applied).

malik (eng): root cause hypothesis: int8 kernel selection path introduced an off-by-one in KV serialization, causing certain KV entries to be misread under longer context lengths. triggers on a subset of traffic patterns we see in canary.

jess (sre): mitigation: rollback to stable + zeroing canary weight + circuit-breaker = mitigation. Next actions: (1) create a regression test for KV serialization boundaries, (2) repro with stress harness, (3) hold rollout until fix and canary pass.

ana (prod-support): I filed customer follow-ups: messaging drafted for impacted customers; CS will send once we confirm RCA.

elena (on-call): handing off to malik (eng) for postmortem & next steps. I'll remain on wall for 15m then sign off.

malik (eng): taking over. starting postmortem doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/x/PM-INC-4821 (draft). tagging research and runtime teams.

jess (sre): recommend severity=P2 (wider mitigation but limited customer impact). schedule follow-up blameless postmortem.

incident-bot: Automated note: retention: keep incident thread. runbook used: Deploy Rollback Playbook v1.2.

elena (on-call): signing off from page. feel free to page me if rollback fails or customers escalate. :thumbsup:

malik (eng): will continue with repro and will not reattempt rollout until tests + canary pass. thanks all. :raised_hands:

devops-bot: Cleanup tasks queued: remove canary artifacts, revert trafficctl entries, notify downstream monitors.

pagerduty: Incident INC-4821 resolved by malik (eng) at 1850012598.

elena (on-call): marking this thread for postmortem scheduling and linking to customer comms. closing thread here.

(reacts: incident-bot :rotating_light:, elena :white_check_mark:, jess :thumbsup:)
